sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:43

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:43:1
items.html: Entirely beneath the place of Malchut of Atzilut: That is, beneath the new point of restriction, where the discernment of Atzilut ends and the place of the worlds of separation begins, as above.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:43:2
items.html: Their place remained vacant beneath the Sefira of Bina. For the GAR, which are KHB, endured, and only the kings from Bina downward were broken, (51) and their place remained vacant. And in this place is the standing of the world of Atzilut after the correction.
